newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Balongan refinery restarted on Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Balongan refinery restarted on Nov 25.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Thursday it has resumed operations at its 125,000-barrels-per-day (bpd) Balongan refinery on November 25 after a routine maintenance shutdown from October 1.
"The Balongan refinery was restarted on Monday. There have been no problems," a Pertamina official told Reuters.
The official, who declined to be identified, said all units at the refinery were running well, including the residue catalytic cracking unit.
The official gave no further details.
The Balongan refinery in West Java is one of eight operated by Pertamina with a combined capacity of 989,500 bpd.
